approved_scope.title: Make evidence prune --apply recheck protections and restore partial removals
approved_scope.description: Make evidence prune --apply recheck protections and restore partial removals
acceptance_criteria: A protection appearing between removals stops the apply and restores every earlier removal byte-for-byte without overwriting a recreated file; a later artifact or observation removal failure also restores earlier removals and appends the existing restored ledger event; successful pruning keeps its current eligibility, authorization, ledger and JSON behavior, and existing history remains readable

answers.constraints: REQ-history-001 and REQ-history-004 keep eligibility, protection, ledger and bound behavior unchanged; specs/history/context.md says evidence retention lives in src/evidence.rs and warns against adding native reads to closeout; #55 supplies remove_verified and restored-event prior art
